All-Hands Bot: we're live! toss your reactions, snack raids, and post-show karaoke signups here :tada:
Jordan: shoutout to design for the slick slides, that color palette slapped :sparkles::clap:
Tess: bringing celebratory balloons to the SF office after this meeting :balloon: who wants one?
Rohan: yes pls, will trade for cupcake :cupcake:
Maya: I'll bring the cupcakes if someone volunteers napkins and coffee :coffee:
Bea: I can do napkins and stirrers. also leaving a tiny paper crown on the cupcakes for dramatic effect :crown:
LunchBot: Friendly reminder: label your leftovers. Unlabeled items will be considered communal after 48h :calendar:
Jordan: poll: post-all-hands karaoke 1 1 duet slots available. React with :microphone: to claim
Tess: :microphone: taking first slot. duet theme suggestion: 90s power ballads
Rohan: I'm in for a duet as long as there's dramatic key changes :musical_note:
Maya: live snack checklist: cupcakes (Maya), balloons (Tess), napkins (Bea), coffee (Jordan). Someone pick up creamer?
Bea: I'll stash some creamer in the mini-fridge, label 'For Ceremony' :label:
Jordan: GIF for the infra update: <https://giphy.com/gifs/success-confetti|confetti success>
All-Hands Bot: recording + slides up in #all-hands within 30m. Karaoke signups closed 10m after meeting. Thanks for the vibes :sparkles:
